title: Why Is Mulching Necessary in Rooftop Gardening?
content: Mulching is necessary because breaking soil clods after irrigation helps keep the soil aerated, allowing plant roots to breathe properly.

title: How Is Mulching Done in Tubs or Pots?
content: Mulching is done by lightly loosening the soil and spreading it evenly around the base of the plant without damaging the roots.

title: What Problems Occur If Mulching Is Not Done?
content: If mulching is not done, soil becomes compacted, air circulation to the roots is reduced, and plant growth becomes slow and weak.

title: Why Should Mulching Be Done in Tubs or Drums?
content: Mulching in tubs or drums helps retain soil moisture, controls weed growth, and keeps plants healthy for a longer time.
